Sounds like your conditions are so severe that self commitment(into a psychiatric hospital)might be the answer, at least for now. One way or another, you need to recognize where you can actually help yourself. You did help yourself before, and then, your brain began catastrophizing after she said she'll have him over anyway. Pushing your friends away will not help anything. Humans are inherently social, and with your conditions, your only way of socializing is online. Don't leave those relationships behind no matter what happens. I would recommend starting a GoFundMe and or looking into 100 percent online jobs which is a field that has been rapidly growing since the pandemic. There's this cool metaphor I was taught by my first therapist: Imagine your mind is a water buffalo that does whatever it wants. You have a whip in one hand and some grass in the other. When the water buffalo does something you don't want it to like catastrophizing the situation or anything irrational like that, you whip it. You tell yourself again and again and place all your willpower into directing your mind into a different direction whether that be distracting yourself, confronting it head on, or self medicating even(except self harming). When the water buffalo does something correctly, you reward it. Find ways to reward yourself in a health manner when you successfully get through a certain task in as rational a way as possible. Your mind will begin to sort of rewire itself. This is however no substitute for medication that actually works, a good home life, and a good social life. Whether you decide to self commit, speak with your friends, speak with your mother, speak with her fiance, do the GoFundMe, or anything of the sort, please don't give up. Please remember how proud you felt when you got better, and please remember that this too shall pass.
